invariants.rationale: A valid rollback operation likely requires a non-null instant time string.
A rollback operation should be associated with a specific commit instant.
An empty rollbackInstantTime may indicate an invalid or incomplete request.
deleteInstants is a boolean input and always true or false; this records that fact in a formal way.
skipLocking, as a boolean, is always true or false; this records that nature in a formal way.
